scope: Missing Power Up Super category member plus Fighting Pose G duration reconciliation

records.name: Fighting Pose J
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 17 - Ginyu and the Fruit

records.name: Fighting Pose G
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop after The Ginyu Force Strikes
records.effect: Increases Ki Blast skill damage by about 8%
records.reason: The current page displays a 20-second Stats duration but its Properties specify 25 seconds for Male Saiyans and 20 seconds for Female Saiyans and other races. Both are retained as separate fields.

reconciliation_note: Fighting Pose J was missing from the repository's prior Power Up Super research despite being one of the current category's 20 entries. Adding it completes category coverage without counting the corrected Mach Dash Evasive record. Fighting Pose G's race-dependent duration is now represented instead of flattening it to a single universal value.
